testCommand: for d in plugins/* mods/*; do claude plugin test "$d" || exit 1; done
checks: claude plugin validate . && for d in plugins/* mods/*; do claude plugin validate "$d" || exit 1; done
notes: Read CLAUDE.md first. Before writing hooks or tests, read .claude/rules/engine-rules.md. Pure rules go in hooks/<name>-logic.ts; every $ call in hooks/register.tsx. Bump the plugin's version in its plugin.json and in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, and add a dated '## Change <version> (<date>)' section to its SPEC.md.
